name: lead-email-finder
title: Email find and verify
description: A name and a company domain in, a work email out (Findymail, then Hunter), then verified (Clearout, then Hunter) when the user presses Verify. Hunter's opt-out stops the run. Ships on the Acme sample; each provider needs a data contract before it serves real lookups.

actions.title: Find an Email Address from a Name
actions.reason: First email finder; spends a credit only on a verified find.

actions.title: Instant Verify Email
actions.reason: First verifier; no answer is free.
